jobs.title: Manager EDI
jobs.desc: Hi, weâre Gravie. Our mission is to create health benefits that actually benefit small and midsize businesses and their employees. Our innovative benefit solutions and services are developed and delivered by a diverse group of unique people. We encourage you to be your authentic self - we like you that way. A Little More About The Role: Weâre looking for an Manager, EDI to own how Gravie exchanges eligibility, enrollment, and claims data with our partners and internal systems as our book of level-funded health plans grows. This leader will report to the Director of Configuration and will build and lead a team that configures, tests,and monitors these connections, while setting the standards that keep them accurate, secure, and scalable.. This role carries meaningful latitude to shape process, tooling, and team structure, and is expected to represent EDI in cross-functional forums. You Will: â Lead, develop, and scale a team of EDI analysts, including hiring, mentoring, performance management, and cross-training so no process depends on one person. â Own the EDI program, including standards for file specifications, mapping, naming, scheduling, and documentation, and maintain an inventory of every trading partner, file, and schedule with a clear owner for each. â Manage new trading partner setup from requirements through UAT and go-live, translating business needs from Product, Enrollment, Operations, and Finance into clear technical specifications. â Oversee daily monitoring of inbound and outbound X12 transactions (834, 837, 835, 278, and acknowledgments such as 999, TA1, and 277CA), and drive failures and rejects to root cause. â Establish error handling, alerting, reconciliation, and QA standards so issues are caught before members, providers, or groups are affected. â Own EDI trading partner, clearinghouse, and vendor relationships, including SLA performance and escalation resolution. â Manage off-cycle changes, renewals, and system upgrades without disrupting daily processing, and lead cross-functional planning for open enrollment and Q4. â Ensure all data exchange follows HIPAA, privacy, and security requirements, including secure transfer (SFTP and encryption), and partner with Security and Compliance on reviews and audits. â Help shape and drive the automation roadmap, evaluating tools and approaches (including APIs and connectivity platforms) that deliver measurable efficiency and quality improvements. â Build runbooks, documentation, and compliance practices that hold up under audit. â Provide visibility to leadership on volumes, error rates, turnaround times, risk, and capacity across EDI. â Act as the primary escalation point for complex, high-stakes EDI issues, exercising independent judgment to resolve risk before it reaches leadership. â Demonstrate commitment to our core competencies of being authentic, curious, creative, empathetic, and outcome oriented. You Bring: â 7+ years of healthcare EDI experience, including 2+ years leading a team in EDI, configuration, claims operations, or healthcare IT. â Deep working knowledge of HIPAA X12 transaction standards (834, 837, 835, 278) and acknowledgments, and how they integrate with enrollment, claims configuration, and adjudication. â Hands-on experience with file validation, mapping, and troubleshooting, including reading raw X12 and identifying loop and segment issues. â Experience in benefits administration, enrollment and eligibility, or claims processing, ideally in a TPA, payer, or carrier environment. â Experience managing trading partner onboarding, testing, and UAT, and working with clearinghouses or vendors against defined SLAs â Working knowledge of SFTP and secure file transfer practices. â Strong communication and cross-functional relationship-building skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders. â Ability to operate strategically while remaining close enough to the details to guide the team through complex technical problems. â Ability to deal with ambiguity, shift gears comfortably, and take decisive action without having the total picture. â Strong organizational, time management, and prioritization skills, with the judgment to know what needs leadership visibility versus what the team should own. Extra credit: â Experience with EDI and integration tools â SQL skills for data validation and reconciliation. â Familiarity with API-based integrations, FHIR, or 270/271 transactions. â Experience supporting system integrations or large-scale platform migrations. â Previous experience in a startup or high-growth company environment. People at Gravie care deeply about making a positive impact in the lives of the people we serve. jobs.title: Cloud Engineer Automation
jobs.desc:
Working for a company like Smile Digital Health means supporting our mandate for #BetterGlobalHealth . We strive towards this goal every day, and the results can be seen in the impact of our innovative health data platform and data management solutions, which are used in over 20 countries. We were #19 on Deloitte's Technology Fast 50 Ranking for 2024! Smile Digital Health makes it easy for healthcare stakeholders to collect and exchange data with our leading FHIR-based data liberation platform. At its heart, the Smile platform enables people and organizations to better manage healthcare data. We help generate and liberate structured healthcare data to ensure effective delivery across care teams and health systems bringing #BetterGlobalHealth to patients everyday! Apply today and find plenty of reasons to SMILE! The Cloud Engineer (Automation) is responsible for designing, building, operating and improving production-grade automation for Smile Digital Health, its clients and partners. This role will be responsible for the pipelines, infrastructure as code, environments and recovery procedures, that the platform runs on. This Engineer will merge direct platform engineering expertise with driving strategic changes in how the department designs, deploys, and maintains its infrastructure. Key responsibilities include managing build and release engineering, orchestrating the Terraform and Helm infrastructure, provisioning on-demand environments, and implementing automated recovery. This role works closely with Platform Engineering, Solution Engineering, Service Operations and Engineering Practice QA to remove unnecessary repetitive, manual work and effectively optimize a build from the time the client commits to a running environment faster, decrease platform costs, and utilize AI to enhance the platformâs engineering and operations. 
 Responsibilities: Own build and release engineering by reviewing the current repositories and CI setup, then consolidate duplicated Azure DevOps pipeline YAML onto shared reusable templates with change detection and automated quality gates. Identify and eliminate manual efforts for cross-functional teams and replace them with scheduled, auditable automation. For example, automating patching, certificate and secret rotation, environment scaling, and recurring reports Implement GitOps-based continuous delivery - declarative, Git-driven deployments with automated reconciliation, drift detection and rollback. Automate line-of-business environments end to end, provisioned and torn down on demand across every Azure service and application involved. Automate business continuity and disaster recovery through backup validation, restore and failover, recurring DR drills, and measured RTO and RPO. Ensure Helm and Terraform are easy to upgrade by charting reuse and configuration validation, versioned modules, and state boundaries that limit how far an upgrade reaches. Run in-cluster platform services deployed through Helm, harden workloads for availability and capacity: health probes, replica counts, and right-sized requests, limits and autoscaling. Ensure that the Terraform configuration is regularly maintained. Build and maintain Build Agent images for streamlining tooling available for the builds. Automate the guardrails such as policy-as-code, security and IaC scanning in the pipeline, and alerts and dashboards defined as code. Implement AI-assisted engineering in the platform teamâs day-to-day work Contribute to the departmentâs AI enablement, package knowledge into reusable skills and runbooks in the shared skill library. Work with the development and operations teams to find automation gaps, prioritize them, and close them. Troubleshoot production and staging issues and document what you automate so others can operate it. Requirements: 6+ years of hands-on cloud engineering, DevOps and/or platform engineering experience, including at least 1-2+ years with infrastructure as code and CI/CD automation on Microsoft Azure in production. Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar and/or equivalent work experience. Practical in-depth knowledge and expertise in Terraform, Helm and Azure DevOps pipelines, and GitOps delivery (Argo CD or Flux). Strong Terraform skills including, but not limited to, experience with module design, provider version management, state management and refactoring. Expertise in Helm chart authoring and refactoring, including recent experience with Kubernetes and AKS. Demonstrated knowledge across Azure (AKS, Key Vault, Storage, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, networking, identity) and observability as code (Azure Monitor and/or Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry). Hands-on experience automating backup, restore and failover with measured RTO and RPO. Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools (Claude Code or equivalent), keeping confidential data out of them and reviewing what they produce. Hands-on experience running, hardening and right-sizing production workloads on Kubernetes Hands-on Kafka operations: topic and partition design, consumer group sizing, and throughput and latency trade-offs. Experience migrating between Kafka platforms (HDInsight, Confluent, MSK or self-managed) is a strong asset. Strong Python and Bash skills, able to build maintainable tooling, not glue scripts. A demonstrable record of replacing manual processes with automation. FinOps practice and Azure Cost Management, an asset. Regulated environment experience (healthcare, PHI), an asset. Certifications: HashiCorp Terraform Associate; Microsoft AZ-104, AZ-400, AZ-305; CKA or CKAD, an asset. Observability as code with Azure Monitor, Grafana, Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry; Azure cost optimization, an asset. 
 $120,000 - $140,000 a year

All hiring decisions are ultimately made by qualified human decision-makers, and AI tools are used to support â not replace â fair and equitable hiring practices. This position is a new role, created to support Smileâs continued growth and commitment to operational excellence. Some of the benefits we offer: * Remote Work Environment * Flexible Time Away From Work Policy including PTO, Personal and Sick Days * Competitive Salary and Health/Medical Benefits * RRSP/TFSA/401K Employee Contribution * Life and Disability * Employee Assistance Program * FHIR Study Program and Skillsoft Learning * Super HAPI Fun Club Smile's core values include respect, inclusion, embracing our differences, and celebrating shared values because our people are the foundation of our success. We are big on creating a sense of belonging and empowering each other to bring our authentic selves to work. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace that values diversity, equity, and inclusion. jobs.desc: h2 class= sc-1npqnwg-4 sc-1npqnwg-5 sc-1uwf3m5-0 ghXWGq custom-css-style-job-description Job description /h2 p strong Team amp; Reporting Line: /strong Program Management Team | Reports to Lead Project amp; Procurement Manager /p p class= Paragraph SCXW53634494 BCX8 span style= color: rgb(61, 116, 204); strong Our Mission /strong nbsp; /span /p p At constellr, we use thermal intelligence from space to understand what is happening on Earth – where, when and at scale. Our satellite constellation delivers high-resolution land surface temperature data, giving governments, defence organisations, commercial operators and global institutions the intelligence they need to monitor change, assess risk and make better-informed decisions. /p p From national security and critical infrastructure to agriculture and climate resilience, constellr turns temperature into actionable intelligence for a changing world. /p p span style= color: rgb(61, 116, 204); strong Your Role /strong /span /p p We are looking for a proactive and detail-driven team player nbsp;to join our nbsp;Product and Quality Assurance (PQA) team, with a strong focus on nbsp;Flight Software Product Assurance. /p p In this role, you will play a critical part in ensuring the nbsp;quality, safety, and reliability of both flight and ground software nbsp;across our growing satellite constellation. You will work at the intersection of nbsp;engineering, quality, and operations, helping to shape how we build and deliver software in a nbsp;fast-moving, mission-critical space environment. /p p The PQA team defines and maintains the company’s nbsp;quality and Product Assurance standards. Your work will directly contribute to ensuring our software meets the nbsp;highest levels of robustness, compliance, and reliability, supporting mission success in both nbsp;orbit and ground operations. /p p This is a role for someone who thrives in nbsp;complex, technical environments, enjoys working across disciplines, and is comfortable balancing nbsp;structured quality processes nbsp;with the pace of a rapidly scaling space organisation. You will be trusted to take nbsp;end-to-end ownership, bring clarity to ambiguity, and help embed strong nbsp;engineering discipline across the software lifecycle. /p p span style= color: rgb(61, 116, 204); strong Key responsibilities /strong /span /p ul li p Develop, implement, and continuously improve a robust nbsp;Software Product Assurance (PA) programme, reporting directly to the nbsp;Product Assurance Manager. /p /li li p Take nbsp;end-to-end ownership of Software Product Assurance nbsp;across both nbsp;flight and ground software nbsp;for our satellite constellation. /p /li li p Ensure rigorous application of nbsp;software configuration management and release processes, maintaining strong nbsp;version control, traceability, and engineering discipline. /p /li li p Enforce compliance with nbsp;safety-critical and mission-critical software standards, with a strong focus on nbsp;risk reduction and failure prevention. /p /li li p Define and oversee nbsp;software testing, verification, and validation strategies nbsp;across all development and delivery phases. /p /li li p Investigate, manage, and resolve nbsp;software anomalies nbsp;throughout development, testing, integration, and operational phases. /p /li li p Support nbsp;Spacecraft Assembly, Integration and Testing (AIT) nbsp;activities, ensuring nbsp;software readiness and compliance nbsp;at every stage. /p /li li p Coordinate and lead nbsp;software deliveries from suppliers, ensuring alignment with nbsp;internal standards, schedules, and quality expectations. /p /li li p Participate in nbsp;subcontractor reviews and key technical meetings, working closely with nbsp;procurement engineers and Product Assurance stakeholders. /p /li li p Balance the demands of nbsp;rapid development cycles nbsp;with the need to maintain strong nbsp;Product Assurance and software quality standards nbsp;in a fast-paced space environment. /p /li /ul h2 class= sc-1npqnwg-4 sc-1npqnwg-5 sc-1uwf3m5-0 sc-1uwf3m5-1 kIUTHT custom-css-style-job-requirements Job requirements /h2 p span style= color: rgb(61, 116, 204); strong About you /strong nbsp; /span /p p strong Required: /strong nbsp; /p ul li p Degree in nbsp;Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a related scientific discipline. /p /li li p Proven experience in nbsp;Flight Software Product Assurance within the space industry. /p /li li p Strong understanding of nbsp;software testing, verification, and validation nbsp;in nbsp;safety-critical environments. /p /li li p Experience with nbsp;embedded flight software for satellites, spacecraft platforms, or payload systems nbsp;(experience with nbsp;FDIR nbsp;highly desirable). /p /li li p Strong proficiency in nbsp;software configuration management tools and processes. /p /li li p Familiarity with nbsp;ECSS standards, particularly nbsp;ECSS-Q-ST-80C (Software Product Assurance) nbsp;and nbsp;ECSS-E-ST-40C (Software Engineering). /p /li li p Strong nbsp;analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with experience in nbsp;risk management and anomaly investigation. /p /li li p Ability to manage nbsp;competing priorities and deadlines, with a proactive approach to nbsp;risk identification and escalation. /p /li li p Strong nbsp;team mindset, with a desire to help nbsp;build and shape a growing organisation. /p /li li p Comfortable working nbsp;independently, taking ownership and delivering in a nbsp;fast-paced environment. /p /li li p Excellent nbsp;written and spoken English communication skills. /p /li /ul p strong Nice to Have em : /em nbsp; /strong /p ul li p Experience with nbsp;automation, scripting, or AI-assisted engineering tools nbsp;(e.g. prompt-based workflows). /p /li li p Exposure to nbsp;high-growth or start-up aerospace environments. /p /li li p Broader understanding of nbsp;end-to-end spacecraft systems engineering lifecycles. /p /li /ul p span style= color: rgb(61, 116, 204); strong Why join constellr? /strong /span /p ul li span style= color: rgb(61, 116, 204); strong High-Impact National Security Mission: /strong /span nbsp;Be part of an ambitious mission to launch the world’s first commercial thermal infrared constellation, delivering sovereign-grade behavioural intelligence from space to close critical blind spots for defence, intelligence, and maritime surveillance agencies. /li li span style= color: rgb(61, 116, 204); strong Fast-Paced New Space Innovation: /strong /span nbsp;Work at the leading edge of a rapidly evolving defence sector. By leveraging modern, agile New Space methodologies, you will help design, build, and deploy dual-use thermal payloads into operational orbit at a speed and scale that traditional aerospace models simply cannot match. /li li span style= color: rgb(61, 116, 204); strong Broad Interdisciplinary Exposure: /strong /span nbsp;Accelerate your professional growth by collaborating daily with a diverse, international cohort of astrophysicists, software developers, and defence-system engineers. /li li span style= color: rgb(61, 116, 204); strong Inclusive amp; Scientific Culture: /strong /span nbsp;Join a high-trust team deeply committed to diversity, inclusion, and scientific excellence, where academic curiosity is paired with high autonomy and a flat hierarchy. /li li span style= color: rgb(61, 116, 204); strong Financial Upside amp; Well-being: /strong /span nbsp;Benefit from a Virtual Share Option Plan (VSOP) for permanent employees, giving you a true stake in the company s growth, alongside highly flexible hybrid working models. /li /ul Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
